title: Whisker Prospector
html:
Whisker Prospector

Race:Whisker

Class:Melee

Whisker Prospectors are found in and around the mines of Algernon. Some of them carry a special potion which greatly increases their size. It is not clear whether it also increases their fighting ability.

Special

Whisker Lookouts are small versions of prospectors which rarely attack.

The Whisker Miner carries a Mining Pick. It is necessary to dispatch him and obtain the pick to mine the Fizz Rock Veins found in and around the Whisker mines.
